description: RAG eval set for the RIDE knowledge system. Corpus: the VHKnowledge knowledge base shipped in VHUnityURP-Internal (rewritten to spoken prose 2026-07-29; corpus/ is a copy, corpus-old-wiki/ holds the June wiki scrape the pre-2026-07-29 numbers were measured on). Each pair: a question a researcher/participant might plausibly ask, and the corpus page(s) whose content answers it. A retrieval hit = any top-k passage comes from an accepted page. Mix: roughly half keyword-friendly, half paraphrase-hard (marked hard=true). q21+ added 2026-07-29 for the new topics; q31-q32 added later the same day after the 'which labs' incident (tuning edge #7). Numbers are only comparable at the same pair count.
